from three different localities in Bangalore city from the year 2015.
Locality Annual average of SO 2 in the air
(volume/volume)
P 16.3 mL/m 3
Y 16.3 ppb (m /m ) 3 3
Z 16.3 ppm (m /m ) 3 3
